title: strategic_output
description: Deterministic anti-fragility (Taleb) metric block produced by scripts/analyze.py (the `strategic` key). The Strategic agent interprets these numbers against the RAG knowledge corpus; it never recomputes them.

convexity.description: Payoff convexity to a symmetric price shock; ~0 for a linear long book.

stress_asymmetry.description: Mean best-tail + mean worst-tail return. <0 = left tail deeper (concave/fragile).

barbell_safe.description: Weight fraction in the safe sleeve (cash + short bonds).

barbell_mid.description: Weight fraction in the fragile middle.

barbell_aggr.description: Weight fraction in the aggressive/convex sleeve.

drivers.description: Per-driver 0..1 fragility contributions feeding the composite score.
